name: recodingapp
description: Desktop recorder for screen, window or region with cursor zoom, camera and microphone

scripts.install:mac: bash -lc 'APP_PATH=$(find dist -maxdepth 2 -name "Neem.app" | head -n 1); if [ -z "$APP_PATH" ]; then echo "Build app not found in dist."; exit 1; fi; rm -rf /Applications/Neem.app; cp -R "$APP_PATH" /Applications/; xattr -cr /Applications/Neem.app; codesign --force --deep --sign - /Applications/Neem.app; echo "Installed and ad-hoc signed /Applications/Neem.app"'
scripts.reinstall:electron: rm -rf node_modules/electron && npm install && npm run resign:dev

extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Neem records your camera as an optional bubble in your screen recordings.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Neem records your microphone as the voiceover track of your screen recordings.
extendInfo.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: Neem saves finished recordings to your Movies folder.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Neem opens finished recordings in Finder.
